note: Pre-validation: not checked against manual counts. Pixel units. Headline measures: roots_count, ring_length_r30_px, the per-field canalicular_length_density_per_px, and the canalicular width (width_median_px per image, ring_width_mean_r30_px per lacuna). owned_length_px, edge_count and mean_edge_length_px depend on which cell owns which thread, which is unbounded in distance; they are network descriptors, and edge_count is not canaliculi per cell. The width is quantised by the pixel grid (threads are about 2 to 6 px wide) and moves with the threshold. Summary statistics cover interior lacunae only.

biological_limits.status: report only, nothing is pruned or filtered by this block

thread_length.definition: along the network from the owning lacuna's surface to a thread end

roots_per_lacuna.definition: threads leaving the lacuna surface, interior lacunae only

apparent_width.definition: 2 x the distance transform of the mask at each sampled skeleton pixel
apparent_width.why: it includes the optical blur, which widens a thread beyond its true size, and no point spread function is subtracted: the numerical aperture, the emission wavelength and the pinhole are unknown. It is an apparent width in the image, not a canalicular diameter.

network_shape.status: report only, nothing here filters or prunes

canaliculi.threshold: hysteresis on the ridge response, high cut = its lower 3-class multi-Otsu cut
canaliculi.lacuna_attach_rule: a node attaches only if the dimmest ridge response on the straight path from the lacuna surface to it reaches that fraction of the response's own low cut

quantification.width_definition: 2 x Euclidean distance transform of the canalicular mask at each skeleton pixel
